name: discord_search
description: Search the Discord server internally — messages, members, channels, threads, roles. Use THIS TOOL when the user wants to find messages, look up a member, list channels/threads/roles, or retrieve conversation history on the server. NOT a web search — this searches the server itself.

action.description: What to search for: 'messages' to search message content, 'members' to find server members, 'channels' to list channels, 'threads' to list threads, 'roles' to list roles, 'history' to retrieve a channel's message history

query.description: Text to search for (required for action 'messages'). E.g. 'how to install python'

channel_id.description: Discord channel ID to restrict the search to that channel only

author_id.description: User ID to only return messages from that author

has.description: Filter messages that contain this type of attachment

pinned.description: If true, only return pinned messages

top_n.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-25, default 5)

user_id.description: User ID for the 'members' search action

role_id.description: Role ID to filter members or search for roles

channel_type.description: Channel type filter for the 'channels' search action

include_archived.description: Include archived threads in results (default true)

include_members.description: Include the member list for roles (default false)

limit.description: Max results for the 'history' action (1-100, default 25)

before.description: Message ID to paginate results before that message

after.description: Message ID to paginate results after that message
